title: Project switcher
responsibility: Lets a person switch between listed projects or open another local project.

inputs.name: ProjectSwitcher.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying current project, project list, snapshot and navigation operations. After switchProject resolves, the dropdown resets to the resulting workspace project identifier.

outputs.name: ProjectSwitcher
outputs.description: Dropdown grouped into local-device/connected-computer projects and Shared projects. Shows Add local project only for a local workspace with a bridge and disables it while busy. Selection changes call switchProject. This component does not catch rejected promises or display switching errors.
